blurb: Parasail World offers parasailing adventures in locations including Waikiki, Marathon Florida Keys, Fort Lauderdale, Key Largo, Miami, and Oahu. Guests fly at various heights up to 1000 feet, enjoying scenic views from the air. Boats are state-of-the-art and USCG trained captains and crew provide safety briefings and assistance.
extraNote: Reservations highly recommended (Waikiki) · Photos and videos available for sale · Shuttle transport to activity platform (Waikiki)
